theorem: Exact intertwining makes every experiment whose preparations lie in Ran(R) and whose effects are coarse-compressed completely insensitive to the complement generator B. Conversely, complement-resolving preparations and measurements recover exp(-tB); because it is positive definite for self-adjoint B, the principal logarithm reconstructs B uniquely from one exact time. The displayed odd-fiber survival probabilities distinguish mu=0.3,1,4 while all coarse heat responses agree to numerical precision.
